records.title: 10-K
records.text: Revenue: Revenue increased $72.5 million, or 4.8%, to $1.599 billion in 2022 from $1.526 billion in 2021.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: We have operated and reported as a single sales segment, OPTAVIA, since 2018.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The increase from changes in operating assets and liabilities was primarily due to a $187.8 increase in the change in inventories partially offset by a $91.9 million decrease in the change in accounts payable and accrued expenses.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The year-over-year growth in revenue was primarily driven by an increase in the number of active earning OPTAVIA Coach count and higher productivity per active earning OPTAVIA Coach through the first two quarters of the year, as well as a pricing adjustment in December 2021 in which the Company increased prices for most of its products by an average of 3.5%.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Income from operations: Income from operations in 2022 decreased $31.4 million to $184.8 million from $216.2 million in 2021 primarily as a result of increased SG&A expenses partially offset by increased gross profit.
